candidate.note: Bound by the parent at the final freeze, in the one equipment commit whose only parent is this candidate (pushed as qualification/update-windows-<first 12 hex>). run.ps1 refuses placeholders before any download; qualify.py --bind-only refuses a candidate checkout whose HEAD or tree differs and an equipment commit that changes anything beyond devtools/update_windows_qualification/ and its workflow.

release.note: Size and SHA-256 from the parent's verified GET; source_sha is the v7.8.0 tag commit the app's repo_bundle_manifest.json must name.
